models_evaluated: FDA-cleared adult-trained AI tool for intracranial hemorrhage detection (unnamed)

links.outcome: Performance of adult-trained ICH AI tool applied to pediatric patients aged 6-17
links.effect: Sensitivity 94.2% (162/172), specificity 94.7%, accuracy 94.6%, PPV 62.5%, NPV 99.4%; performance comparable to adult performance, though false positives were common.
links.quote: An adult-trained AI tool demonstrated high sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy for ICH detection in pediatric patients aged 6-17 years, comparable to its adult performance.

links.outcome: Generalization of adult-trained AI performance to a different (pediatric) population
links.effect: Sensitivity 94.2% (95% CI 89.6-97.2%), specificity 94.7% (93.6-95.7%), comparable to adult performance across 21 sites.
links.quote: An adult-trained AI tool demonstrated high sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy for ICH detection in pediatric patients aged 6-17 years, comparable to its adult performance.

links.outcome: Multi-site performance validation of AI for ICH detection
links.effect: Pooled analysis across 21 sites gave sensitivity 94.2% and specificity 94.7%; results were not reported separately by site or device.
links.quote: This retrospective, multi-institution study analyzed consecutive pediatric NCHCTs performed between January 2017 and November 2022 across 21 sites.

links.outcome: Performance when extending an adult-trained model to a new pediatric population
links.effect: Sensitivity 94.2%, specificity 94.7%, NPV 99.4%, but PPV only 62.5%; false positives from streak artifact (21.6%) and misclassified anatomy (18.6%).
links.quote: AI correctly identified ICH in cases missed by radiologists, but false positives were common, most often due to streak artifact (21.6%) and misclassified anatomy (18.6%).

screen.reason: Retrospective multi-institution off-label validation of an FDA-cleared adult ICH detection AI model on pediatric head CTs, evaluating diagnostic performance across age groups without testing a specific deployment practice.
